summary: Observed during protected enrollment recovery: the published0.114.4 constructor refused its descendant main solely because the accepted postpublication registry flip changed dist/dotnet/.config/dotnet-tools.json from0.114.3 to0.114.4 inside its build closure. Separately, an active Project inventory omits archived enrolled cards although issue.projectItems retains them. Reconcile missing predecessor nodes through the maintained complete exact-project identity/pagination reader, requiring explicit archive state, and preserve the original enrollment prefix; do not infer removal from absence. Conflicting, partial or unarchived reads remain Unknown. Original Unsupported evidence and effects stay immutable. A successor requires supported runtime/reader rebinding and joint archive binding, commitment, reader and matching acceptance receipt qualification before activation; neither a prior receipt nor a source merge authenticates new inputs.
title: Protected enrollment must distinguish release registration from source drift and archived from absent membership
